entries.german:
Karl IV. nimmt das Zisterzienserinnenkloster in Camposolis (Sonnenfeld), Würzburger Diözese, in seinen besonderen Schutz, bestätigt dessen Freiheit von Vogteirechten, von Centgerichtsbarkeit usw.

Zeugen: venerabilis Johannes Argentinensis episcopus et illustres Rupertus iunior Bavarie, Bolko Opuliensis et Heinricus Lignitzensis duces, spectabiles Burghardus burggravius Magdeburgensis, imperialis curie magister, Heinricus et Guntherus de Swartzpurg et Johannes de Retz comites ac nobiles Johannes de Rosemberg et Hasco de Zweretitz, imperialis camere magister, et alii quamplures sacri imperii principes, nobiles et fideles.
entries.english:
Karl IV takes the Cistercian nunnery at Camposolis (Sonnenfeld), in the Diocese of Würzburg, under his special protection and confirms its freedom from rights of bailiwick, from cent-court jurisdiction, and so forth.

Witnesses: the venerable Johannes, Bishop of Strasbourg; the illustrious Rupert der Jüngere of Bavaria, Bolko of Opole, and Heinrich of Liegnitz, dukes; the distinguished Burghard, Burgrave of Magdeburg and steward of the imperial court; Heinrich and Günther von Schwarzburg and Johannes von Retz, counts; and the nobles Johannes von Rosemberg and Hasco von Zweretitz, master of the imperial chamber; and many other princes, nobles, and faithful men of the Holy Empire.
